LearnerProgress.title: LearnerProgress
LearnerProgress.description: Stores a learner's ukulele curriculum progress, daily practice streak, best streak, and tricky lesson bookmarks.

uid.description: The authenticated Firebase user UID owning this progress record.

displayName.description: Learner display name shown in the academy header and progress dashboard.

currentLessonNumber.description: Current active lesson number from 1 to 44.

completedLessonNumbers.description: Bounded list (max 50) of completed lesson numbers.

knownDifficulties.description: Bounded list (max 44) of lesson titles marked tricky for review.

practiceMinutesTotal.description: Cumulative practice minutes logged across lessons and timers.

dailyStreakCount.description: Current consecutive daily practice streak count.

bestStreakCount.description: Highest consecutive daily practice streak achieved.

lastPracticeIsoDate.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent practice activity.

practicedIsoDates.description: Bounded list (max 30) of recent ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) when the learner practiced.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the learner profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the learner progress was last updated.

PracticeSession.title: PracticeSession
PracticeSession.description: Individual practice session log stored in a subcollection under the learner document.

uid.description: Owner Firebase UID matching parent learner document.

lessonNumber.description: Lesson number practiced during this session (1 to 44).

minutes.description: Minutes practiced in this session (1 to 240).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the session log was created.

/learners/{userId}.description: Stores per-user ukulele curriculum progress, daily streak, and review queue keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/learners/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Subcollection of practice history logs belonging to a specific learner.
